items.name: theme
items.title: nb theme
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: The house theme: slate ground, hairline borders as rgba tints, 10px uppercase micro-labels, tabular figures, pill state, 8px card radius, and the single warm cream note reserved for search-match highlight. Lifted verbatim from stratechery-search. A `registry:theme` item, so it installs as cssVars plus a css string that the CLI merges into the consumer's own stylesheet: there is no target file, the consumer keeps its @import "tailwindcss", and no import line is added.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Sticky top bar on an opaque ground, wordmark, a top-level tab nav with aria-current (links or router buttons), back pill on non-root views, 68rem main, and footer strip. The house application frame.

items.name: stat-strip
items.title: Stat Strip
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: KPI summary cards (label, big tabular-figure value, sub-line) in a responsive grid. Lifted from deepseek-balance and stratechery-search.

items.name: result-list
items.title: Result List
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Ranked entity list with title, meta, status pill, and a progressive fold disclosure. Generalised from stratechery-search.

items.name: filter-panel
items.title: Filter Panel
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Facet filter card on desktop; chip row and bottom sheet under 600px. Replaces custom filter layouts.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Cause-aware zero-result card: distinguishes narrow filters (with clear-filters action) from misspelled queries.

items.name: status-view
items.title: Status View
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Four-card status lanes (pending, done, stuck, blocked) with counts in the head and pill badges. Lifted from data-download §8.

items.name: detail-panel
items.title: Detail Panel
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Entity inspection card: title, status pill, two-column metadata grid, prose body, and history.back() navigation.

items.name: burst-timeline
items.title: Burst Timeline
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Interval burst sparkline chart + historical audit grid with labelled comparison columns ('Explains').

items.name: bar-series
items.title: Bar Series
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: A labelled bar chart with a computed value axis, per-bar display strings, and a dashed projection bar. The measured-value counterpart to burst-timeline's sparkline. Lifted from deepseek-balance's daily spend, usage and cost charts.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Column-aligned records in a card: header labels, right-aligned tabular numerics, hairline rows, and a cell slot. Wraps per record under 600px. Lifted from data-download's request book and plan-type schema.

items.name: request-form
items.title: Request Form
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Schema-driven input form with constraint error presentation (one message per failed rule). Lifted from data-download §7.8.

items.name: meter-strip
items.title: Meter Strip
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: A capacity bar (used against a ceiling, as a filled bar with a role=progressbar) over a row of figures. Lifted from devdash, where the same strip is both the page's header and the NAS dashboard's iframe.

items.name: action-list
items.title: Action List
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: One row per thing you operate: name, state pill, metadata badges, and the actions that are valid for that row right now. Per-row slots for the buttons, a note and an aside. Lifted from devdash's project list.

items.name: device-mirror
items.title: Device Mirror
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: A live mirror of a remote device: a freshness heartbeat, the screen it is drawing (or its headline), a relayed countdown, a state word and a live banner. The card is a second view of the hardware, not a dashboard about it. Lifted from galactic-unicorn-remote's panel mirror.

items.name: command-pad
items.title: Command Pad
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: One large press per command, in a grid, each carrying its own glyph and tone: available, in flight, confirmed, or disabled. Read-only it becomes the legend of the same keypad, with the active command lit. Lifted from galactic-unicorn-remote's routine buttons.

items.name: message-bar
items.title: Message Bar
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: One short line sent to something: a field wrapped by its label, a caller-owned character rule, a length cap, and a pending Send. The single-line counterpart to request-form. Lifted from galactic-unicorn-remote's idle-screen composer.

items.name: confirm-prompt
items.title: Confirm Prompt
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: An action that would interrupt something: name the conflict and give two answers, Replace and Keep, with the confirm button bindable so the caller can move focus. Lifted from galactic-unicorn-remote's routine conflict.

items.name: log-view
items.title: Log View
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: A job's output in a panel: head with a state pill, an optional notice, a monospace pane that scrolls itself, and an action row. The pane is bindable so the caller can follow its tail. Lifted from devdash's build/provision log.
